question: Simplify: 6 × [28 ÷ 84 × {36 × 49 ÷ (6 × 7)}]
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify: 6 × [28 ÷ 84 × {36 × 49 ÷ (6 × 7)}]

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS)

**Calculation:**

6 × [28 ÷ 84 × {36 × 49 ÷ (6 × 7)}]

⇒ 6 × [28 ÷ 84 × {36 × 49 ÷ 42}]

⇒ 6 × [28 ÷ 84 × 42]

⇒ 6 × [28 ÷ 2]

⇒ 6 × 14

⇒ 84

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
